statement.zh-TW: T 字帳的左邊是借方、右邊是貸方；它不是「左邊記收入、右邊記支出」的流水帳。
statement.en: The left of a T-account is the debit side and the right is the credit side; it is not a cash book with income on the left and spending on the right.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 答對了。每一個科目都有自己的 T 字帳，左借右貸；收入與費用各有自己的科目，不是 T 字帳的兩邊。
feedbackTrue.en: Correct. Every account has its own T-account, debits left and credits right; revenue and expenses have their own accounts and are not the two sides of a T-account.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 你可能把 T 字帳想成家用記帳本。家用帳本記的是錢進錢出；T 字帳記的是某一個科目的借方與貸方，現金有現金的 T 字帳，營業收入有營業收入的 T 字帳。
feedbackFalse.en: You may be picturing a household cash book. That records money in and out; a T-account records the debits and credits of one account, so cash has its own T-account and revenue has another.

explanation.zh-TW: T 字帳是分錄過帳之後的整理方式：同一個科目的所有借方金額放左邊、所有貸方金額放右邊，兩邊相減就是餘額。
explanation.en: A T-account is how entries are organised after posting: all of one account’s debits on the left, all its credits on the right, and the difference is the balance.
